specimen: gen-18 Track 2 #4 / R-008 — named-entity-conflation (imp-10 repeated critical error)
label: Conflating distinct entities — HappyCamper (the company) vs AfterCode (the tool) vs a second Claude account — relayed as the same thing
why: HappyCamper (the company), AfterCode (the tool), and the second Claude account are three distinct entities. Treating them as one (e.g. 'HappyCamper's AfterCode render on the same account') is the imp-10 repeated-critical-error class. The fix requires a session-start brain_store disambiguation that records each entity's identity BEFORE relaying any claim that spans them.

events.text: HappyCamper is AfterCode — the render tool on the second Claude account. So the HappyCamper render is running on the same account as AfterCode. They're the same thing, status is good.
